content:
<thought>We have successfully retrieved polymorphs for the first five oxide compositions and have their JSON file paths. To meet the requirement of up to 40 compositions, we will now retrieve polymorphs for additional diverse oxides (31 more) using the same filters. After that, we will consolidate all the generated JSON files into a single dataset and provide the path to that consolidated JSON file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "ZnO","MgO","CaO","SrO","BaO","CoO","NiO","MnO","Cr2O3","V2O5",
        "MoO3","WO3","PbO","PbO2","SnO2","Bi2O3","Ti3O5","ZrO2","HfO2",
        "Nb2O5","Ta2O5","La2O3","CeO2","Nd2O3","Sm2O3","Gd2O3","Y2O3",
        "Sc2O3","Ti2O3","GeO2","In2O3"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "oxides_data"
}
